# claude-venice

> claude-venice is a free, open-source Claude Code CLI launcher for macOS that runs Claude Code against a local venice-bridge web subscription in an isolated profile with zero API cost.

## What it does
- Launches `claude` in an isolated `~/.claude-venice` profile (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) so the official Claude Code login stays untouched.
- Routes `/v1/messages` through `venice-adapters` (`127.0.0.1:18892`) -> `venice-bridge` (`127.0.0.1:18891`) -> `venice.ai` web plan.
- Enables `--dangerously-skip-permissions --permission-mode bypassPermissions` by default (including on `--resume`), with `--lean` MCP disabling, `--models`, and `--quota`.

## Install & Use
- `git clone https://github.com/nsozturk/claude-venice.git && ln -s "$PWD/claude-venice/claude-venice" ~/.local/bin/claude-venice`
- `claude-venice` · `claude-venice --lean` · `claude-venice -m <model-id>` · `claude-venice --quota` · `claude-venice --models`
